phases.title: Foundation
phases.summary: Build the protected foundation before allowing the Personal AI to become increasingly autonomous.
phases.detail: This phase established identity, ownership/provenance, protected governance, persistent learning, sandbox self-coding, research/computer tools, multimodal foundations, resource efficiency, gaming coexistence, Discord, game operations, defensive anti-cheat, the agent factory, and isolated external-project integration.
completed: Independent Personal AI identity and Git foundation
Protected core, checkpoints, recovery, and owner authority
Persistent memory / learning records and local model runtime
Sandbox self-coding with test → fix → retest loops
Research, computer tools, vision, image, video, and voice foundations
Resource governor and gaming coexistence controls
Discord, owned-game operations, and defensive anti-cheat foundations
Agent factory with inherited protected rules
THE LONG AFTER sandbox integration with real-project write protection
phases.verification: All 16 foundational gates closed. Gate 15 verified intentional failure detection, repair + Godot retest, protected-core/regression checks, and unchanged real-project fingerprint.
phases.unlocks: A governed platform strong enough to begin Personal AI v1 runtime work.

phases.title: Unified Runtime Foundation
phases.summary: Bring the validated foundation systems behind one deterministic runtime before enabling self-improvement.
phases.detail: The AI's protected core, memory, local model, self-coding, research/tools, resource controls, and project boundaries were unified behind a single runtime baseline.
phases.verification: Deterministic targeted tests PASS; critical-resource defer PASS; unified runtime self-test PASS; full regression PASS; protected-core verification PASS; checkpoint PASS.
phases.unlocks: A stable known-good runtime that can safely evaluate controlled self-change.

phases.title: Self-Improvement Engine
phases.summary: Teach the runtime to test candidate changes, reject regressions, promote better changes, and roll back failed promotion.
phases.detail: Self-improvement moved beyond simply writing sandbox code. Candidate changes became measurable: worse changes are rejected, beneficial candidates can be promoted after safeguards, and failed post-promotion validation rolls back to the known-good state.
phases.verification: Worse self-change rejected PASS; better self-change benchmarked/promoted PASS; failed post-promotion validation rollback PASS; learning record PASS; regression PASS; protected core PASS; checkpoint PASS.
phases.unlocks: Controlled, measurable self-improvement without surrendering owner governance.

phases.title: Adaptive Hardware Optimizer
phases.summary: Make the AI learn how to use the owner's actual hardware efficiently and adapt when hardware pressure changes.
phases.detail: The runtime now fingerprints machine capabilities, observes CPU/RAM/GPU/VRAM/disk pressure, adapts concurrency and workload strategy, records strategy outcomes, and falls back safely across different hardware conditions.
phases.verification: Machine fingerprint PASS; hardware profile PASS; GPU/VRAM fallback PASS; pressure strategy PASS; adaptive concurrency PASS; strategy learning PASS; cross-hardware fallback PASS; regression PASS; protected core PASS; checkpoint PASS.
phases.unlocks: A runtime that can intelligently conserve resources and coexist with gaming / foreground workloads.

phases.title: Unified PersonalAI.exe v1
phases.summary: Package the validated runtime into the unified owner-facing PersonalAI.exe v1 application surface.
phases.detail: This is the active next build phase. The executable becomes the unified way to start and operate the AI while preserving the protected core, self-improvement safeguards, hardware adaptation, checkpoints, rollback, and clean Git state.
targets: Runtime + self-improvement + hardware optimizer behind one executable
Checkpoint / rollback visibility and recovery path
No weakening of project isolation or owner control
phases.verification: Not yet complete. Phase closes only after executable startup tests, targeted tests, regression, protected-core verification, checkpoint, and clean-state checks pass.
phases.unlocks: A single practical Personal AI application instead of separate development-stage components.

phases.title: Post-EXE Operational Autonomy
phases.summary: Turn the unified executable into a persistent desktop companion that can safely carry longer tasks under owner control.
phases.detail: This phase is intentionally not locked into exact sub-steps until the EXE phase is verified. The direction is persistent operation, better task continuation, scheduling, recovery, and owner-visible control without expanding privileges blindly.
phases.verification: Planned direction only. Detailed acceptance tests will be defined after Phase 04 closes.
phases.unlocks: A useful always-available AI that can operate across longer periods without constant prompting.

phases.title: Expanded Specialist Agent Network
phases.summary: Expand the agent factory into a richer team of governed specialist agents working through the unified AI.
phases.detail: Specialists can become more capable, but every child agent continues to inherit the protected master rules, project isolation, resource limits, and owner authority.
targets: Explicit task scopes and permission inheritance
phases.verification: Future phase. Exact agent benchmarks will be defined when activated.
phases.unlocks: Parallel specialist work without creating independent uncontrolled systems.

phases.title: Deep Research & Knowledge Expansion
phases.summary: Extend source-grounded research into deeper, longer-horizon investigation and project knowledge workflows.
phases.detail: The focus is higher-quality research, source tracking, evidence retention, project-specific knowledge, and longer investigations while preserving privacy and source separation.
phases.verification: Future phase. Detailed benchmark suite will be defined when activated.
phases.unlocks: A stronger research partner for software, game development, technical work, and new domains.

phases.title: Multimodal Expansion
phases.summary: Deepen vision, image, video, voice, and audio capabilities while keeping them modular and resource-aware.
phases.detail: The foundation already exists; this phase turns those foundations into more capable practical workflows integrated with the Personal AI runtime.
phases.verification: Future phase. Modality-specific acceptance tests will be defined when activated.
phases.unlocks: A more complete multimodal local assistant.

phases.title: External Project Operations
phases.summary: Scale the sandbox-first integration model to more external projects without merging their identity or granting uncontrolled writes.
phases.detail: THE LONG AFTER provides the first validated integration pattern. Future projects should receive the same isolation, scoped agents, controlled promotion, and real-source protection.
phases.verification: Future phase. Project-specific acceptance gates will be created as integrations are added.
phases.unlocks: A Personal AI platform that can safely operate across multiple owner projects.
phases.next: Further phases will be defined from verified results rather than guessed in advance.
